verdict.rationale: RUN documents running payroll online, by phone, or on mobile, plus AI import of timesheet hours and AI error flagging before payroll takes effect, with automatic payday deposit. This covers the core of entering hours, catching issues, and submitting. There is no description of a single guided flow with a review of earnings and a preview of totals before submission. Missing for 10: documented earnings review and preview-totals step, evidence the cycle happens in one end-to-end flow, hands-on or independent corroboration of the payroll-run workflow.
